content:
This PR #43286 is the group theoretic material for the standard Hecke theory in RepresentationTheory. The main motivation is to describe the intertwining space Hom_G(k[G/H₁], k[G/H₂]). However, the naive double coset module k[H₁\G/H₂] is not isomorphic to Hom_G(k[G/H₁], k[G/H₂]) in general. We have to put some finiteness condition either on the subgroups H₁ H₂ (e.g. commensurable, open compact) or on the double coset H₁gH₂. We choose the second, more general approach, and this PR is the price we pay.

For a triple (H₁, H₂, g), the property DoubleCoset.IsLeftFinite H₁ H₂ g says that the double coset H₁gH₂ admits a finite decomposition into left cosets, i.e. the set {xH₂ | H₁xH₂ = H₁gH₂} is finite. The collection of all such double cosets is bundled into a type DoubleCoset₀, which allows us to describe Hom_G(k[G/H₁], k[G/H₂]) as the free module k[DoubleCoset₀ H₁ H₂]. We also provide some finiteness instances which help define convolution product of double cosets.

We deliberately design two indexing types for the left-coset decomposition: the intrinsic LeftDecomposition and the computational LeftDecompQuotient. They are equivalent via toLeftDecompositionEquiv. The first is useful for coordinate-free definitions and proofs, which saves us from abusing Quotient.out everywhere (note that we have three quotients in Hecke theory: G/H₂, H₁/H₁∩gH₂g⁻¹, H₁\G/H₂) and avoids "choosing representative from decomposition in the def => proving the def does not depend the choice + repeating this kind of argument for comparing different representatives in many downstream proofs" pattern. The second LeftDecompQuotient carries a fixed base point gH₂ and remains useful for concrete convolution product computation.

Review order:

#43327 introduces the decomposition of a double coset into left cosets: the intrinsic LeftDecomposition and the computational LeftDecompQuotient.

#43328 introduces the finiteness condition DoubleCoset.IsLeftFinite as a prop class and provides instances.

#43286 introduces the bundled version DoubleCoset₀ with necessary API lemmas.
